question: Which complete downstream attention-module or MLP writes carry the dominant is-was effect of the compact L7H7+L9H4 writer intervention that bypasses L11H3?
intervention: Capture each complete attention c_proj output and MLP output in native and selected-writer runs. In a separate native run, replace one module's output by its selected-writer-run output at every position through the is-was query, then score its controlled mediation against the complete selected-writer effect.

split.selection: Original FIT ranks eligible modules by pooled signed recovery and retains at most four.
split.validation: Original HOLDOUT cannot change module identities or thresholds.
split.promotion: Only modules that pass HOLDOUT may enter OOD and within-attention head splitting.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_writer_replay_m: All immutable authorities, selected writer identities, pair/source/query maps, 16 module capture/patch call counts, writer replay, finiteness, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_l11_attention_module_replays_the_: A11 recovers at least 0.10 of the is-was writer effect with cosine at least 0.90 on FIT and HOLDOUT, proving the complete-module mediator is live without requiring it to close the bypass.
predictions.pred_c_original_fit_nominates_a_non_l11_: At least one module other than A11 passes the FIT recovery, cosine, and direction gates.
predictions.pred_d_fit_selected_modules_validate_on_: Every retained FIT-selected module passes the frozen HOLDOUT gates without reselection.
predictions.pred_e_module_mediators_are_temporally_s: Every retained module's temporal-command effect is at most 0.01 of temporal command gold.

null: If A or B fails, the module-output instrument is invalid. If C fails, the bypass is distributed below a 0.20 single-module screen at this grain. If D fails, FIT module localization is unstable. A passing module is a causal screen, not an identified head or standalone circuit; it must pass OOD and within-module splitting before promotion.
next_if_pass: Split passing attention modules into their nine physical heads and compare their exact induced write tensors; for passing heads/MLPs, contract the bypass tensor through exact downstream weights to rank readers before OOD causal confirmation.
anti_rank_drift: This is full native module patching. No rank, fitted subspace, DAS, reconstruction, variance, or compression objective is used.
